phase: independent interpretation; authored expectations unseen; not gate approval
method: Manually interpreted packet revision 5 and every inventoried source. No manifest, cases.md, expected JSON, authoring scripts, other reviewer reports, production extractor or parallel Markdown parser read. Helpers locate manually chosen exact snippets and perform hash/coordinate checks only. Public Engine 3.5.0 parse/normalize probes confirmed node structure/raw source, never Trace semantics. Offsets are UTF-16, zero-based, end-exclusive. O aliases are local source-order occurrences; owners name declaration aliases. Explicit source snippets describe context partitions; incidental inter-block blank separators are not owned content. Graph integrity outcomes exclude language-case required-relation assertions. Scenario validation uses the example profile unless the input overrides it. Unspecified integrity diagnostic codes/messages remain unspecified.

scopeNotes: This frozen report covers all 79 case memberships and all distinct source semantics. Full API DTOs, exact generated IDs/diagnostic strings, generalized checker, production/runtime APIs, public exports, pilot measurements and gate acceptance are deferred. Each reference occurrence specifies exactly one relationship; its local alias can serve as an edge alias for direct/backlink comparisons.
